question: In a certain code language, 'FWOD' is coded as '23-6-14-25' and 'SINH' is coded as '10-20-15-21'. How is 'TYLB' coded in the given language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Letter opposite place value + 2.**

'FWOD' is coded as '23-6-14-25

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75fa60e4565668efe18e7d707f9ee2f0fd529a66ed89e3f0efdfdc79484a59b1.png] 

'SINH' is coded as '10-20-15-21'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0276ea75e65dde78f932d39d65d2adb0855b31cb9494206a8f4c8b35a2f8965a.png] 

Similarly,

'TYLB' is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83bfbb269f23b1285a156f28d4f742e0db0c896f6629d945db92b30e5cf86486.png] 

Thus, 'TYLB' is coded as 9-4-17-27.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
